_doc: The gate registry: the ONE enumeration of this repo's node gates. A gate is a script that exports EXIT_CANNOT_CHECK (the repo's own definition of 'three outcomes, three exit codes'). Every projection of the suite -- the justfile recipes, the CI workflow steps, and the proof that each gate can produce each of its exit codes -- is asserted against this file by scripts/ci/gate-inventory.test.mjs. Add a gate by APPENDING one object to `gates`; never reflow the file, so concurrent additions stay compatible. Field order is stable: key, script, test, recipe, fixtureRecipes, ciStep, ciFixtureStep, blocksCi, exits, verdictWaived.

_fields.script: repo-relative path to the gate itself
_fields.test: repo-relative path to its fixture suite -- the thing that proves it can still go red
_fields.recipe: justfile recipe that runs the gate's own verdict, or null (then verdictWaived is required)
_fields.fixtureRecipes: justfile recipes that run `node --test <test>`; at least one
_fields.ciStep: `- name:` of the .github/workflows/ci.yml step that runs the verdict on the binding rung, or null (then verdictWaived is required)
_fields.ciFixtureStep: `- name:` of the ci.yml step that runs the fixture suite
_fields.blocksCi: true when the gate's recipe is a dependency of the `ci` recipe, so the local ladder and the merge pipeline are the same policy
_fields.exits: every exit code the gate's paired test must assert against a SPAWNED process, not an in-process call
_fields.verdictWaived: why this gate has no standing verdict rung; present only when recipe or ciStep is null

gates.verdictWaived: A Stop hook that judges ONE transcript handed to it on stdin; there is no standing tree to run it against, so the fixture suite IS the rung. Run `node scripts/docs/check-doc-sync.mjs <transcript>.jsonl` to replay one by hand.

_reportDoc: `reportModes` is how a gate joins the posture table that `just quality` (scripts/ci/quality-report.mjs) prints. Keyed by gate key; a gate with NO entry, or an entry with no `command`, still gets a row -- NOT WIRED -- because an inexpressible condition must still enumerate. `command` is argv, spawned with the repo root as cwd, and MUST be the gate's non-mutating mode (disk-check therefore carries --no-prune: the posture is read-only by construction). `remedy` is the command a human runs when that row is red -- refusal-names-a-reachable-remedy, asserted by quality-report.test.mjs to start with `just` or `node` and to name only paths that resolve inside this repo. `self: true` marks the reporter's own entry, which is the one row it must never emit.
